cleanup: Install no background worker; pipe bounded responses directly to the data reader; use no temporary/cache files. Preserve partial/failure receipts and do not retry. No existing source, report, shared cache, SDK/toolchain or process is a cleanup target.
platform_qualification: Current Apple upstream main is a declared source reference, not an attestation of the future macOS 15 Intel runner kernel/libc. Actual required symbol/ABI/toolchain observations and exact CTest binary/source-version binding remain fresh implementation and admission gates. Missing exact-version facts remain explicitly unadmitted.
coordination: Stop all tool commands when root requests quiescence for its sole-owned Linux build. This source-data operation is not another build/test job and transfers no execution slot.
